items.title: Removing a closed irreducible subset from a connected space requires the ambient space to be irreducible
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement concerns the irreducibility of a space from which a closed irreducible subset has been removed, under the hypothesis that the whole space is connected (author lemma at source lines 1439-1444, label lemma-remove-irreducible-connected). The author's own proof at source lines 1446-1454 follows it immediately and is its proof, arguing from a hypothetical decomposition of the ambient space and using the irreducibility of the closed subset and connectedness to contradict the hypotheses on the complement (proof lines 1446-1453). The case analysis on a decomposition is the content. H2.
